title: Conditional κ = 0.001600067494703216: width-seven providers and whole-owner packing
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This adds a conditional finite construction at **κ = 0.001600067494703216**, improving PR564's 0.001593134158181640 by **0.435201%**.

Three extra exact cold relations and 32 entrance-frame promotions create width-seven residual helpers. Whole-owner repacking uses 63 width-seven calls and nine plain four-cold calls, allowing 9+7 pairs in rank-sixteen owners. The complete complex profile is `{1:169056, 2:41184, 3:25968, 4:13824, 5:4032, 6:4032, 7:48, 8:576, 48:1808}`. Dimension 73, live stock 7168, physical stock 7682 and rank deficit 2560 are unchanged.

The native complex rate is **0.001602631813774414678548**. The conservative model separately passes at κ = **0.001600067491919801**. The unchanged cited PR543 bit supplier remains nonbinding.

The package also records exact capacity/stage dual bounds, bounded negative geometry searches, and explicitly hypothetical helper-cost targets for larger gains. These are distinguished from admitted constructions.

**Dependency and attribution:** PR564 is pinned at `c18417b02b80594b2ca1c8c21185d28befafc935`; its source package is an external replay input, not republished in this diff. Root main is pinned at `db0e57bc7f36b5ac0fc844ad7ce1396165ee6647`. Inherited notices and source/adaptation hashes are retained. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used.

PR567 and PR568 appeared during this work and report further cold-kernel improvements. They were fetched for comparison but are not replayed or composed here; the numerical comparison above remains against the freshly reproduced PR564.

All inherited all-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-basis, normalized residual, correlated whole-owner, precision/tape and analytic-transfer assumptions remain. This is not an unconditional multiplier theorem, complete Lean proof, or worst-case O(1) indexing result.

### Attribution and new contribution

with substantial OpenAI Codex (GPT-6 Astra) assistance in mathematical
exploration, implementation, verification and documentation. The new work is
the additional checked suffix relations, coupled width-seven entrance
promotions, their literal whole-owner assignment, exact model exclusions and
portable replay. It builds on the following contributions.

external dependency. These contributions are not independently additive
numerical gains.

## Validation

- Complete pinned PR564 reproduction: all 36 stages passed.
- New local providers: all 728 columns in both orientations, dirty restoration, exact frames, phase recipes and endpoint adapters passed.
- New global construction: physical chronology and all 16 owner mutations; complete finite invoice; both independent exact moment engines; 47 strict outer conditions per model; all 89 assembly mutations rejected; two timing-only phase changes accepted and two semantic changes rejected.
- Exact relaxed upper bounds are checked with rational duals and independent engines, including corrupt-certificate controls.
- `make gen4-bank-verify` passed. The broader `make verify` run reached an inherited C++ target requiring unavailable Boost headers. This is not recorded as a pass.
- Portable replay completed: all 71 fresh provider stages followed by all seven global stages passed, reproducing both exact kappa values. The final receipts and log hashes are retained in `global/replay-evidence/`.

Full reproduction from the new package, with the exact PR564 checkout available:

```sh
python3 -B research/larger-gain/global/reproduce.py \
  --source /path/to/pinned-PR564/research/complex-allcold \
  --work /tmp/width7-reproduction
```

The output directory must be new. See `research/larger-gain/README.md`, `global/width7/RESULT.json`, and `global/README.md` for the proof scope, retained checks and source-bound reuse options.
